I can sense the destinies
of individual people, but
not Acedia as a whole.

rows.label: tlk47100072_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I wonder what kind of story
Acedia's destiny will become.

rows.label: tlk47100072_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Phonexes love hearing
stories, so I'm very curious
to learn Acedia's story!

rows.label: tlk47100072_02_msg0004

My fur is standing on end! It looks
like I'll get to see an incredible
story of destiny! I can't wait!
